description: pyam is a Python package for analysing and visualising integrated-assessment and macro-energy scenarios. IIASA and the pyam developer team provide tools for scenario time series, plotting, validation and processing of model assumptions and outputs. The package supports the IAMC yearly-data template, with model, scenario, region, variable and unit dimensions. Geographic and temporal coverage follow the supplied scenario collection. Source code is public on GitHub, releases are archived on Zenodo, and Apache-2.0 permits free reuse. pyam prepares and compares scenario data; it does not itself simulate physical infrastructure flows. Users must keep units and variable definitions consistent when combining models. The package can support comparisons of energy-transition scenarios alongside model-pypsa, without implying that their outputs are interchangeable. It was not installed or executed during review.
